name: Green Gruff | 12 ct. | Soothe Plus
description:
SOOTHE Skin & Coat soft chews provide our dogs with extra benefits that help promote healthy skin. With regular use in their diet, SOOTHE soft chews may support healthy skin that can be altered by everyday activities, aging, lack of dietary oil, or dust and dirt from outdoors.

Active Ingredient Amount Per 2g Soft Chew

CBD 5mg

Organic Hemp Protein 240mg

Organic Cricket Protein 180mg

Organic Kelp 115mg

Organic Flaxseed 100mg

Organic Hemp Seed Oil 40mg

Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil 30mg

Hydrolyzed Yeast 5mg

Full Spectrum Hemp Extract 2.5mg

Other Ingredients:

Organic Barley, Salmon Hydrolysate, Palm Fruit Oil, Organic Brown Rice, Coconut, Sunflower Lecithin, Cellulose Powder, Coconut Glycerin, Natural Smoke Flavor, Sorbic Acid, Zinc Proteinate, Rosemary Extract, Mixed Tocopherols.

Cautions:

If dog's condition worsen or does not improve, stop product administration and consult your veterinarian. Safe use in pregnant animals or animals intended for breeding has not been proven. May cause diarrhea in high doses or sensitive animals. Administer during or after the animal has eaten to reduce incidence of gastrointestinal upset.

For use in dogs only.

SOOTHE soft chews may help to maintain healthy skin that is prone to being damaged by regular activities, dust, and filth from the environment.

Directions for use Administer Orally.

Weight of Dog Soft chews per day

Under 10 lbs.1

10-25 lbs.2

26-50 lbs.3

50+ lbs.4
